decision_reason: The available raw UBCv2 assets and locally generated seed901 set do not identify the GDROS authors' screened 1447-pair test split or their three test transformations/ground truth.

available_raw_asset.extraction_note: Each extracted modality also contains one .tif.aux.xml sidecar; these are not images. The available raw pair count does not establish the authors' screened split.

local_generated_asset.manifest_prescreen: none (all official test pairs kept; paper pre-screened to 1447)
local_generated_asset.classification: locally generated paper-style affine set, not author GT/split

missing_to_unblock: All three author test seeds or the three realized transformed test groups
Author ground-truth flows/warps and exact transform realization
Exact screening and split assignment needed to map the available raw pairs
An author UBCv2 checkpoint if comparison to the paper's target-trained GDROS row is intended
prohibited_interpretations: Do not report the existing 1625-pair seed901 evaluation as official UBCv2 reproduction.
Do not choose or discard pairs based on model error to force a 1447-pair set.
Do not compare a single locally generated seed's pairwise standard deviation with the paper's three-seed mean plus/minus standard deviation.
